title: The Little Book of Faults
hook: What did the trying look like each day?
counterintuition: You might think a man fixes faults by hating them. He wrote them down.
keyTakeaway: Name each fault in writing and you have already begun to mend it.
tryThisNow: Write down one small fault from today.

breakdown.fastRead:
He kept a little book.

He was happier for the trying.
breakdown.deepRead:
He kept a little book with a page per virtue.

Order was hardest.
breakdown.fullRead:
He grew up counting shillings.

He kept a book.

Order was hardest, and he was happier for the trying.

questions.explanation: Writing it down is the first move.

memorableLines.text: Write the fault down and half the work is done.
